title: Chapter 245
text:
There was no pop-up window, it was free to read!

The tunnel was winding, and after walking for a while, the front suddenly opened up.

In front of them was an empty underground tunnel, and the exit of this secret tunnel was at the top of the underground tunnel wall, about five meters above the ground.

The air was full of dust and moldy smell, abandoned and bleak, and there were large pieces of spider webs hanging on the wall. The main door of this underground tunnel had been locked and had not been used for many years.

Hella jumped down with Aurora, raising a cloud of dust, and Han Xiao also jumped down.

"This is an early underground tunnel, abandoned after the expansion of the headquarters, and no one has been maintaining it. I dug a secret tunnel in the ventilation pipe to here, the gate and cameras are all gone, and the railway is also broken, we have to go out, the exit is a secret door on the ground at the edge of the headquarters, and the whole tunnel will take about four hours to walk."

Han Xiao looked back at the entrance, "Won't they catch up?"

"No one knows we are here, but it's best not to be careless." Hella carried Aurora on her back and strode forward.

Han Xiao followed, walking side by side, and threw out a few small triggered mines, if someone caught up, this part of the tunnel would collapse.

The three of them moved forward, and the atmosphere was silent.

The situation was tense just now, so there were many things that they did not have time to investigate. Now that they had time, Hella had more doubts in her mind, and she frequently looked at Han Xiao.

Hella had some things to ask, but she was used to the cold personality, so she pursed her red lips and did not speak.

Aurora was lying on Hella's back, burying her head in her sister's dark red hair, smelling her sister's body fragrance, her face was full of comfort and peace, and she looked at Han Xiao shyly.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, "Little brat, why do you keep looking at me?"

Aurora whispered, "Don't you have a name, or is it just Zero?"

Hella pricked up her ears.

"Han Xiao, my name."

"Sister said you were brainwashed, and I don't know how you escaped."

Han Xiao pretended to be a swindler and said meaningfully, "Everything has its own destiny."

Hella secretly rolled her eyes.

"Big sister said that you're only in your twenties, but you look so old."

Han Xiao was embarrassed. 'Didn't I disguise myself? This little brat doesn't have good eyesight.'

Turning his gaze away, he saw that Hella was silent. Han Xiao's interest in teasing her was piqued. He smiled and said, "Don't you have anything to say to me?"

Hella supported Aurora on her back and said coldly, "Thank you."

"Your tone is too insincere." Han Xiao casually played with a few bullets. "In order to save your sister, I came all the way here to enter the tiger's den. Even if you don't want to thank me with your body, at least speak politely."

Hella turned her head and asked with a frown, "Where did you find out about my sister? What are your intentions?"

Since the topic had been opened, she just asked. She did not believe that Han Xiao's motive was purely to save her. There must be another purpose … She guessed right, but unfortunately, she did not know that Han Xiao's target was her.

"It sounds like a torture. I am now your benefactor and teammate." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and said jokingly, "You have to have a request attitude when you ask questions."

Hella was still not used to the change of identity. After a moment of silence, she realized that she still could not say the word 'request'. She said stiffly, "Tell me."

"Why? Do you suspect that I'm like the Germinal Organization, controlling your sister to harm you?" Han Xiao laughed. "Maybe I'll try."

Most words that could be said could not be taken seriously. Hella relaxed and said expressionlessly, "What do you want?"

"I want world peace."

Hella gritted her teeth. Han Xiao had been talking nonsense for a long time. He did not say anything substantial at all, so she just stopped talking.

Aurora asked curiously, "My sister told me your story. She said that you are very powerful … Are these all true?"

Oh, Hella actually praised me behind my back.

Han Xiao looked over, but Hila did not react at all. She still had that cold expression on her face, and she did not even look at him. However, as the saying went, not speaking was equivalent to agreeing.

"Of course it's true."
